name: Doorstop
hint: A block marked 4 weighs 4 on a plate. Blocks never get tired.
why4: The bridge needs weight 4 on the plate while everyone crosses, which only the 4-block gives, and it takes four to push it.
solution: P1 stands under the one-way shelf at x=9; P2 jumps onto P1's head; P3 climbs P1 and P2 and jumps up through the shelf (height 4), touches the key at x=9 and drops back down.
Conga-push the 4-block right: P1 against its left side (x=13), P2, P3, P4 lined up behind, all hold Right.
Stop when the block is on the plate (x=22-25; counter 4/4): the bridge E over the 6-wide pit at x=30-35 appears.
Everyone walks over the bridge; P3 opens the door at x=44; all press Down.
Recovery: pushed too far, the block falls in the pit and comes back to its spawn; push it again.
